fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck driveway curves off County Highway H (105th St) into the truck court as an open paved entrance. z20 satellite of the road entrance and three Street-View headings along Highway H show no barrier arm, no sliding gate, and no checkpoint pinch-point. No perimeter fence at the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. No 1-3-vehicle-footprint structure beside the truck lane in any view.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — requires a gate; there is none.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Very wide paved truck court on the east side of the building between the dock face and Highway H gives ample interior holding before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The truck court easily holds a long (3+) truck queue; the curved approach runs several hundred feet.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Docks run nearly the full length of the long east building face; UNFI/USGBC materials cite 54 dock doors for semis at this 425,000-450,000 sq ft facility — `dockDoors` 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large bank of drop trailers parked without tractors fills the east-side truck court — `dropArea` 50+; `dropYard: true`.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a separate smaller building at the SW corner of the property; the second structure's exact ownership/use is not confirmed from imagery — could be a related shop/annex or a separate parcel.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial corridor in Sturtevant/Mount Pleasant WI, with open farm fields on the west and south property lines; rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.status: UNFI announced (March 2026) the permanent closure of this Sturtevant facility, eliminating 443 jobs; consolidation absorbs volume into surviving Midwest DCs. Audit reflects the yard's physical state from current imagery.

citations.claim: UNFI "is consolidating its Racine County operation with a facility in Joliet, Illinois that it plans to expand"; 443 positions eliminated, layoffs expected to begin summer 2026.
Listed as "Sturtevant, Wisconsin" in the FY2025 property table as of 2025-08-02, before the announced closure took effect.

verification.rationale: REJECTED: ANNOUNCED PERMANENT CLOSURE. UNFI is closing its Sturtevant (Racine County) Wisconsin distribution centre and consolidating the operation into Joliet, Illinois, which it plans to expand and upgrade. 443 positions eliminated, layoffs beginning summer 2026. The retrievable reporting does not state a confirmed final closing date, so this rejection rests on the announced permanent closure and the consolidation target, not on a date I do not have. Note the receiving site, Joliet IL, is 28-joliet-il in this same account.
